in_hebrew.name: Athalia
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Goddess of the earth, mother
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Athalia הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek 'Athena', meaning 'goddess'. Athalia is a powerful and nurturing name, symbolizing strength, wisdom, and protection. In the Old Testament, Athalia is the name of a queen who tries to usurp the throne from her young nephew.

in_latin.long_meaning: Etymology from Hebrew root, signifying strength and courage, historically used in early Christian church to describe a female warrior, spiritual significance lies in its representation of feminine bravery and resilience, associated with qualities such as determination and perseverance
